g.text: The frozen HGB has lower deviance than the OOF-selected baseline on both later-year diagnostic sets.
Source: models/diagnostic_metrics.csv. 2024: 7,885 eligible daily cells / 28,182 (28.0%); 103 dates, Jan–Sep.
2024/2025 are NOT untouched future tests and were not used to change model selection. Weather is unavailable in these years.
